purpose: canonical AfSIS Phase I dataset for afsis_experiment.py

coalesce.rule: one row per SSN; first non-null value per column per lab; CROPNUTS and ICRAF outer-joined
coalesce.why_single_table: clean() keeps one row per record with mode='first', which would keep CROPNUTS and drop the ICRAF texture and carbon columns

unused.RRES: C % Org (organic carbon), counted, not used

depth_policy: topsoil selected on the AfSIS depth label; the 0-5 cm interval rule cannot be applied because the source records a categorical label, so the label travels as DepthLabel and the pipeline reports applied=False
grouping: SSN. Site and cluster travel as SiteName/ClusterCode for reporting only.
target_note: total carbon, not organic carbon; see module docstring
